snippet.title: The Crackpet Show - Official Release Trailer - Steam and Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Brutal rogue-lite shoot-em-up The Crackpet Show is now available on PC via Steam and Nintendo Switch!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390700/The_Crackpet_Show
Nintendo of America: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/the-crackpet-show-switch
Nintendo of Europe: https://www.nintendo.co.uk/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/The-Crackpet-Show-2297910.html?s=countries

Become a cuddly homicidal maniac and compete in a violent TV show to earn likes, sponsorships and celebrity status. The Crackpet Show’s full launch features a new main theme created by Happy Tree Friends composer Jerome Rossen, a new Endless game mode, a full campaign with a final boss, and funky jazz tunes made with showstopping slaughter in mind.
